# Where to Watch Jesus Mission


by Angel | August 20, 2026


What happens when ordinary people decide they won’t keep their faith to themselves? In the streets of Nashville, a group of young believers steps beyond their comfort zones to start conversations, share the Gospel, and see what happens when they simply say yes to God.


[Watch Jesus Mission now, exclusively on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/jesus-mission)


### **Faith That Won’t Stay Quiet**


For many believers, sharing their faith with a stranger can feel intimidating. What do you say? What if they reject you? What if you don’t have all the answers?


*Jesus Mission* doesn’t shy away from those questions.


This raw documentary follows young believers in Nashville as they take their faith beyond the walls of the church and into the streets. Some conversations are encouraging. Others are uncomfortable. Some doors open, while others close.


But they keep showing up.


### **One Conversation Can Change Everything**


At the heart of *Jesus Mission* is a simple question: Have you ever shared the reason for the hope you have?


The young people featured in the film wrestle with that question as they learn to move past fear and become more intentional about sharing their faith. Rather than presenting evangelism as something reserved for experts, the documentary shows ordinary people learning to trust God in ordinary conversations.


Sometimes, a single conversation is all it takes to change the direction of someone’s day—or even their life.


### **The Highs and Lows of Evangelism**


One of the most compelling parts of *Jesus Mission* is that it doesn’t present evangelism as easy.


There are moments of courage, rejection, uncertainty, breakthrough, and unexpected transformation. The young believers have to confront their own fears along the way, discovering that obedience doesn’t always mean knowing exactly what will happen next.


As one Guild member put it, the documentary is “a much needed reminder that God meets us where we are and that we don’t have to know it all.”


The result is an honest look at what it can mean to live out your faith when there’s no script to follow.


### **Watch** ***Jesus Mission*** **on Angel**


Whether you’re looking for encouragement to step outside your comfort zone, a firsthand look at evangelism, or simply a reminder of what faith can look like in action, *Jesus Mission* offers an honest and inspiring perspective.


[Watch Jesus Mission today, exclusively on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/jesus-mission)
